name: notion-clone-mcp-test-server
description: Automated test generation MCP server for Notion Clone

scripts.analyze: tsx -e "const server = new (await import('./notion-clone-test-mcp.js')).NotionCloneTestAutomationServer(); await server.analyzeProject(); console.log('Analysis complete')"
scripts.generate: tsx -e "const server = new (await import('./notion-clone-test-mcp.js')).NotionCloneTestAutomationServer(); await server.analyzeProject(); await server.generateTestSuites(); console.log('Tests generated')"
scripts.testall: npm run analyze && npm run generate && echo 'Full pipeline complete'
